study.question: Does allowing auxiliary supervision into the target and deterministic history-summary operands of the task adapter improve click AUC beyond g0-r0031-adapter_context_only, while the scorer, pooled base and direct tower embedding routes remain primary-owned?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0031-adapter_context_only obtains click AUC 0.6670575100016033 versus 0.6668051956575413 with both context routes blocked, 0.6668223631817226 with tower-only context and 0.6669000087261666 with both enabled. Thus the location of auxiliary context transfer matters in this single-seed implementation; it does not establish a general mechanism. Its adapter still cannot update target or history-value embeddings from auxiliary losses. We hypothesize that local auxiliary transfer through the task-conditioned correction can shape those shared representations more usefully than the previously blocked broad item routes. Attaching both adapter operands should improve on the incumbent and both single attachments if useful complementarity exists. This remains uncertain: the auxiliary labels are category/brand-window events rather than advertisement-specific conversions. Earlier replacement compression failed (g0-r0006-compressed_task 0.6591942389399411 versus source 0.660646940486458); more ordinal detail was also unhelpful (g0-r0019-cubic_ordered 0.665704885611003 below gated duplicate 0.6659300360390669). Primary Dice-support operand attachment was useful jointly in g0-r0024-support_inputs_attached 0.666753547526167, while query-only 0.6646155769630264 and history-only 0.665288435647782 were weaker. Those primary normalization-path findings motivate a factorial but do not transfer as evidence for the distinct auxiliary adapter edges tested here.

study.proposed_difference: Introduce two boolean architecture flags: block_aux_adapter_target_grad and block_aux_adapter_summary_grad. During training, for each non-click task only, an enabled target edge supplies the original attached target tensor solely to residual_features; the direct tower still uses aux_target.detach(). An enabled summary edge supplies the original five deterministic summary tensors solely to the adapter signal; base remains primary_strata.detach() and scorer/item tower routes retain original detach guards. Context ownership stays adapter-enabled/tower-blocked. All four cells execute the same tensor arithmetic at a fixed state; only tensor graph connectivity differs. Evaluation uses the inherited values without gradient gating. No new parameters, buffers, losses, input fields, sample filtering, normalization populations or host settings are introduced. Both-blocked is an execution bridge to the incumbent. This is a local gradient-routing experiment with unverified originality.
predictions: Predeclared four cells: A00=adapter_items_blocked (both new gradients blocked); A10=adapter_target_only; A01=adapter_summary_only; A11=adapter_items_both. Primary score is full-population validation click AUC. Predict A11>A00 and A11>max(A10,A01) for useful joint transfer. Positive synergy additionally requires I=A11-A10-A01+A00>0; an additive improvement alone does not establish synergy.

Estimate target effects A10-A00 and A11-A01, summary effects A01-A00 and A11-A10, plus the interaction I. Compare each new result to incumbent0.6670575100016033, stronger frozen source0.660646940486458, other source0.660163362657485 and DIN0.6555440824200336. Only within-suite paired contrasts isolate this intervention.

At identical nondegenerate fixed state and input, all cells should have identical probability and running-buffer updates in train/eval within justified FP32/BF16 tolerance, unchanged initialization/parameter counts, and auxiliary operand Jacobians matching the gates. Zero-final-layer initialization initially suppresses all upstream adapter gradients: test permissible nonzero Jacobians after a declared nonzero final-layer probe or update, never interpret initialization zeros as isolation evidence.

Expected unchanged 32129765 total parameters, 31793216 embedding and336549 dense, with no inference operator additions. Training backprop cost may increase: measure train/wall/allocatedGPU seconds, examples, peak memory, inference throughput and batch p50/p95; do not infer equal measured compute from fixed forward arithmetic.

Report all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately: incumbent auxiliary AUCs cart0.7786742631667221/fav0.8031783016443196/buy0.7561522322355515 remain substantially below DIN0.8490697019534956/0.8648974928883688/0.8701822750556283. No all-task improvement claim is warranted. Reuse predeclared history-length bins (0,1..16,17..64,>64); slice changes are exploratory. A long-history improvement would be consistent with adapter transfer but would not identify the causal source.
falsifiers: If A11 does not exceed A00 and the stronger frozen source on click AUC, the proposed joint benefit is unsupported for this implementation; no failure of all task-conditioned compression methods is implied.

If A11 fails to exceed the stronger single-edge cell, useful complementarity is unsupported even if one edge improves. If I<=0, positive synergy is unsupported. A tiny single-seed difference is preliminary until paired repetition/uncertainty assessment.

If blocked operand Jacobians are nonzero, enabled probes remain spuriously zero after opening adapter final weights, click direct paths change, forward/buffer parity fails, or masking/checkpoint/BF16 checks fail, reject the implementation attribution before interpreting validation scores. Retain charged failed execution costs.

If improvements require additional measured cost without a justified quality-cost tradeoff, report predictive change without an efficiency claim. If auxiliary quality deteriorates, preserve it rather than selecting on a four-task average.
No raw data verification, host dynamic tests, bootstrap, new training or scoring can be executed in this coding phase. Their absence is missing evidence, not a null scientific result.
alternative_explanations: Target and historical item fields share embedding tables. Operand-edge Jacobians, rather than table-level gradients, identify the intervention; updated tables influence all later forward uses.
History-summary attachment jointly includes historical item and action embeddings and five inherited moment families; this suite cannot attribute gains among those components.
Auxiliary gradients also change sparse Adagrad accumulators and future representation geometry. Native Dice couples examples; global dense clipping remains an indirect task coupling.
Single frozen training seed and a heavily explored validation set: no independent replication or significance claim. Same-seed bridge reruns test consistency only.

Better click ranking could reflect altered sparse optimizer histories, regularization or incidental one-pass optimization rather than preservation of complementary history information. Same-forward edge interventions cannot by themselves prove better information content.
Many earlier validation-guided decisions may overfit the validation day. Source bests and DIN have different architecture/cost, so their score gaps do not attribute the adapter edge mechanism.
Official offline delayed feedback and whole-window vocabulary/static snapshots are inherited benchmark assumptions; production point-in-time validity is unestablished.
